shortDescription: Helps govern an Australian company under the Corporations Act. Prepares board records and reviews for human approval.
longDescription: Creates an approved company-governance profile, issue-spots director-duty and conflict controls, prepares controlled board-decision records, reviews governance frameworks and builds source-linked compliance calendars. It verifies current Commonwealth legislation, separates regulated overlays and never files, approves or invents corporate action.
defaultPrompt: Create a controlled governance profile for this Australian company before assessing its governance arrangements.
Assess the governance process and director-duty issues for this proposed company decision.
Prepare draft board decision materials without inventing any meeting event or approval.
Review this Australian company governance framework against verified requirements and approved documents.
Build a source-linked governance calendar without submitting or filing anything.
whatItDoes: Configures a controlled company governance profile
Reviews governance frameworks and builds source-linked calendars
Separates listed, APRA, ACNC, and CATSI overlays
boundaries: Never approves, files, executes, or invents corporate action
